svg.title: Robertsonian gametes with legible source footer
svg.desc: The unchanged accepted twelve-gamete vector component is clipped at y900, below its adjacent-segregation bracket. Its exact footer words are reflowed with the same left-two-column and right-one-column associations. Source ODP slides 57 and 58.

svg.title: Robertsonian translocation gamete products
svg.desc: Source-faithful twelve-gamete comparison of adjacent and alternate segregation with single chromosomes and six fused red-blue chromosomes.
svg.text: All gametes from adjacent segregation are aneuploid; a
rob(14; 21); +21 gamete yields a zygote with trisomy 21.

g.text: All gametes from adjacent segregation are aneuploid;
